prompt:
Use the attached original 4-frame Zoro bass-player sprite strip as the strict character and art reference. Create an EXTENSION animation sprite sheet in exactly the same polished cute 3D chibi toy style, the same short sturdy proportions, large round head, tiny black oval eyes, green spiky hair, three earrings, dark green open coat, red sash, black boots and dark green gold-trimmed electric BASS. Keep original identity, costume details, lighting, camera, bass shape and pose orientation. The player has exactly two arms: his left fretting hand is on the bass neck at image right and his right plucking hand is on the strings above the bass body at image left. Never mirror these. Both arms are naturally connected to shoulders, hands actually touch the bass, no stretching or twisting. 
Deliver a transparent PNG SPRITE SHEET: exactly 16 complete character frames in an evenly spaced 4 columns x 4 rows grid, read left to right then top to bottom. Every cell has the same fixed camera, same character and bass scale, same pelvis center and foot baseline; plenty of transparent space between all cells. The entire character including both boots, hair, instrument headstock is visible within every cell. No labels, text, grid, shadow floor, background or extra objects. This is whole-character hand-drawn cel animation; no exploded body parts, no cutout assembly. 
Frames 1-8 (first two rows) form one subtle smooth continuous bass-plucking cycle: right fingers reach string, contact, release, wrist follows through and returns; left fingers make a small natural fret change; gentle head nod down then up, both feet firmly planted and chest remains upright. Frame8 returns very close to frame1. Frames9-16 (bottom two rows) form one stronger but controlled downbeat/accent cycle: slight anticipation, confident right-hand pluck across the bass strings, small head nod, brief follow-through, return upright. More expressive hand action than first cycle, never an extreme lean. Frame16 returns close to frame9. Maintain the ORIGINAL attractive solid intact silhouette in all16 frames; do not exaggerate anatomy or bend the whole figure. Match the reference rendering closely; do not redesign this character.
